title: System Logs
content: Apply system logs aesthetic with monitoring dashboard feel. Dark background with scrolling log entries. Timestamps in consistent format. Severity level badges: DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, FATAL. Color-coded by severity. Monospace text for log content. Include source/module indicators. Filter and search functionality styling. Real-time streaming appearance. Log file viewer atmosphere.

variants.simple: Create log monitoring aesthetic with timestamped entries, severity levels, and real-time data streams.
variants.detailed: Apply system logs aesthetic with monitoring dashboard feel. Dark background with scrolling log entries. Timestamps in consistent format. Severity level badges: DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, FATAL. Color-coded by severity. Monospace text for log content. Include source/module indicators. Filter and search functionality styling. Real-time streaming appearance. Log file viewer atmosphere.
variants.advanced: Apply system logs aesthetic with production monitoring feel. Background: dark (#0d1117) or terminal black, optimized for long reading sessions. Log entry structure: [TIMESTAMP] [LEVEL] [SOURCE] MESSAGE format, each on single line or wrapped consistently. Timestamps: ISO 8601 format (2024-01-15T14:32:05.123Z), monospace, dimmed color (#6e7681). Severity levels with colors: TRACE (#6e7681 gray), DEBUG (#58a6ff blue), INFO (#3fb950 green), WARN (#d29922 yellow), ERROR (#f85149 red), FATAL (#ff7b72 bright red, background highlight). Level badges: inline labels with background color, uppercase, fixed width for alignment. Source tags: [module:function] or [service.component] in cyan/teal. Message content: primary text color, monospace, can contain JSON (syntax highlighted). Stack traces: indented, dimmed, collapsible. Structured data: JSON pretty-printed with syntax highlighting. Filters: severity toggles, source filters, time range selectors. Search: highlight matches in log content, regex support indication. Real-time: new entries animate in (slide down or fade), auto-scroll toggle, pause indicator. Stats: log rate (logs/sec), error count, time range displayed. Virtual scrolling: handle large log volumes efficiently. Export: copy/download buttons. Correlation: trace ID highlighting, related log grouping. Implementation: virtualized list for performance, efficient DOM updates. Accessibility: severity conveyed by more than color (icons, labels), pausable animations.
